@needs_shell
    def test_acceptance_evidence_gate_cannot_be_overruled_by_final_adjudicator(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        state.task = "Erzeuge answer.py mit answer() == 43."
        coder = ScriptedClient([
            tool("write_file", {"path": "answer.py", "content": "def answer():\n    return 42\n"}),
            tool("shell", {"command": "python3 -m py_compile answer.py"}),
            tool("git_diff", {}),
            FINISH,
        ])
        reviewer = ScriptedClient([
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Der erste Review behauptet Vollständigkeit.",
                "issues": [],
            }),
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Die Anforderung sei erfüllt.",
                "checks": [{
                    "requirement": "answer() muss 43 zurückgeben.",
                    "path": "answer.py",
                    "evidence": "return 43",
                    "reason": "Der geforderte Rückgabewert sei sichtbar.",
                }],
                "issues": [],
            }),
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Dieser Schiedsrichter-Aufruf darf nie stattfinden.",
                "issues": [],
            }),
        ])
        controller = AgentController(
            coder,
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            max_turns=6,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
            max_review_cycles=1,
        )

        with self.assertRaises(AgentError) as ctx:
            controller.run()

        self.assertIn("ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID_AFTER_RETRIES", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertEqual(len(reviewer.requests), 2)
        events = (root / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID_AFTER_RETRIES", events)
        self.assertIn("finaler LLM-Schiedsrichter darf es nicht überstimmen", events)
        self.assertNotIn("Finale Review-Schiedsrichter-Prüfung abgeschlossen", events)
